title: hive-spec define: request body
description: Writes a specification revision: revision 1 of a new specification, or the next revision of an existing one, whole. A revision that changes an accepted criterion invalidates the acceptance and clears the criteria from every item that carried it; the affected items' definition returns to defining. See spec/pool.md, Specifications.

specification_id.description: Absent creates a new specification; present revises it, with the envelope's expected_revisions naming its revision.

task_ids.description: Items this specification is being defined for; each moves to definition defining.
